class.name: OcgXcafdocVismaterialtool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (visualization materials) of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (visualization materials) of TopoDS_Shape in and ! from TDocStd_Document. ! ! This attribute defines the list of visualization materials (XCAFDoc_VisMaterial) within the ! whole document. Particular material is assigned to the shape through tree-nodes links. ! ! Visualization materials might co-exists with independent color attributes (XCAFDoc_ColorTool), ! but beware to preserve consistency between them (it is better using one attribute type at once ! to avoid ambiguity). Unlike color attributes, list of materials should be managed explicitly by ! application, so that there is no tool eliminating material duplicates or removing unused ! materials. ! ! @sa XCAFDoc_VisMaterial

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which colors are stored

method.name: RemoveMaterial
method.description: Removes Material from the Material Table

method.name: SetShapeMaterial_1
method.description: Sets new material to the shape.

method.name: UnSetShapeMaterial_1
method.description: Removes a link with GUID XCAFDoc::VisMaterialRefGUID() from shape label to material.

method.name: IsSetShapeMaterial_1
method.description: Returns TRUE if label has a material assignment.

method.name: SetShapeMaterial_2
method.description: Sets a link with GUID XCAFDoc::VisMaterialRefGUID() from shape label to material label.

method.name: UnSetShapeMaterial_2
method.description: Removes a link with GUID XCAFDoc::VisMaterialRefGUID() from shape label to material.

method.name: IsSetShapeMaterial_2
method.description: Returns TRUE if shape has a material assignment.

method.name: GetShapeMaterial_1
method.description: Returns label with material assigned to shape.

method.name: ID
method.description: Returns GUID of this attribute type.

method.name: GetShapeMaterial_2
method.description: Returns label with material assigned to shape label.
